changes: Clarified the DONE version-bump skip reason in the CLI runtime path, updated the focused version-bump smoke expectation, and documented that CLI patch versions track watched Proofbound CLI/runtime inputs rather than every repository artifact.
usage: Run lattice DONE/version-bump flow or inspect the built constant with node -e; non-watched changes now report: version bump skipped (no watched CLI/runtime inputs changed).
expectedOutcome: A non-watched/non-runtime change no longer reports no material code change; the visible skip line says no watched CLI/runtime inputs changed, while watched CLI/runtime changes still require version bump/build verification.
actualTranscript: node -e read packages/main/dist/core/version-bump.js and printed: version bump skipped (no watched CLI/runtime inputs changed). lattice --version printed Proofbound CLI 0.3.123. version-bump smoke passed: 68 assertions. lattice validate passed 31 configured commands. done_required_validate passed build plus npm test.
outcomeDiff: No difference: the actual transcript matches the expected user-visible skip wording and the runtime/build validation passed.
limitations: This story intentionally does not expand CLI patch bump policy to experiments/** or add a separate experiment/product ledger; it only clarifies the current watched CLI/runtime boundary.
pitfalls: scope_check_save wrote scope-check.json under canonical main rather than the story worktree and required merging main back into the worktree; done_required_validate --help executed the validation path instead of showing help, but it passed and produced usable evidence.
